state.paragraph: On September 18, 2013, CSC/Pamplona submitted a proposal for an all-cash purchase price of $20.75 per share, reiterating that Pamplona was committed to provide 100% of the capital required to consummate the transaction and requesting that CSC/Pamplona and Mac-Gray agree to engage in exclusive negotiations for two weeks. Also on September 18, 2013, Party A reiterated in a telephone call to a representative of BofA Merrill Lynch that its previous indication of interest with an all-cash purchase price of $18.00 to $19.00 per share was its best and final offer. On September 18, 2013, Party B also submitted a revised indication of interest with a purchase price that Party B valued at $21.50 per share, including $19.00 of cash to be paid at closing and the remaining per share price to be paid in the form of options to be issued to Mac-Gray stockholders, representing 10% of the new equity with a strike price equal to Party B's initial cost basis. These options, which we refer to as the Party B options, would vest on the achievement of the base case management projections ( i.e. , over five years), excluding any future acquisitions. Party B's proposal stated that it valued the Party B options at $2.50 of incremental value per share. Party C did not submit a revised indication of interest or reiterate its prior indication of interest of an all-cash purchase price of $16.00 to $17.00 per share nor did it specify any reasons in connection therewith.

ledger_rows.Note: Transaction Committee gave MacDonald a limited process overview so he could consider a rollover; he decided he was not interested in rolling over any shares.
Round 3 opened: SC instructed BofA to request final indications by 09/18/2013, signaling possible short exclusivity depending on price and deal certainty.
Round 3 final due date reached; CSC/Pamplona, Party B and Party A responded; Party C did not submit.
Responded to the final request; Pamplona's 100% funding reiterated; requested two-week exclusive negotiations.
Reaffirmed the standing $18.00–$19.00 indication as best and final in response to the final request; carried from #28; no firm financing commitment.
Package: $19.00 cash plus options Party B valued at $2.50/share (10% of new equity; strike at cost basis); vesting tied to base-case projections over five years; no firm financing commitment.
Did not submit or reiterate its $16.00–$17.00 indication in response to the final request; gave no reasons.
SC concluded CSC/Pamplona offered most value and certainty but should raise its price above $20.75; authorized exclusivity at $21.25; MacDonald supported that price.
Raised to $21.25 as last and best offer, conditioned on two-week exclusive negotiations; requested MacDonald voting agreement; confirmed by telephone.
Inferred: exclusivity with CSC/Pamplona displaced the two live rivals; Party A had declared $18.00–$19.00 its best and final offer.
Inferred: exclusivity displaced the two live rivals; SC preferred CSC/Pamplona's certainty over Party B's debt-funded, option-heavy package.

bid.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a bidder submits, revises, confirms or reaffirms a priced proposal, indication of interest or offer for the company. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.

exclusivity.instructions: `paragraph` reports that exclusivity is requested, authorised, granted, signed or extended. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
